source.post_text:
If the Lakers eventually pivot away from Jonathan Kuminga, there are still a few situations worth watching around the league.

Peyton Watson: Denver is exploring sign-and trade possibilities because of its cap situation, but Milwaukee, Cleveland and the Clippers are also reportedly involved. He’d give LA another young, athletic two way wing, but his next contract could get expensive. 

P.J. Washington: The basketball fit next to Luka Doncic is obvious, and Luka would reportedly be in favor of a reunion.
